blocks.text:
## Journey highlights

In Guatemala, the route takes you through Antigua, Pacaya Volcano, Lake Atitlán, San Juan La Laguna, Santiago Atitlán, the Chichicastenango market, Tikal, Rio Dulce and Livingston.

The journey continues via Quiriguá and Copán in Honduras, then on to San Salvador and the Mayan archaeological sites of El Salvador.

In Nicaragua, the programme covers León Viejo, León, Managua, Masaya Volcano and Granada.

Costa Rica brings nature into the spotlight: Arenal Volcano, the Caño Negro Wildlife Refuge, Monteverde, the Tárcoles River and Manuel Antonio National Park.

The final days are spent in Panama, with Boquete, Barú Volcano, Panama City, the Panama Canal, a visit to an Emberá village in the Chagres area and several days on the Pacific Riviera.

## What makes this programme special

The route includes multiple overland border crossings in Central America, a ferry journey from El Salvador to Nicaragua and two domestic flights.

The Guatemala City–Flores and David–Panama City flights are included in the programme, as confirmed by the approved 2027 itinerary.

The Chichicastenango market takes place on Thursdays and Sundays. Local religious traditions are part of its cultural setting.

There are plenty of active days in nature: a hike on Pacaya Volcano, archaeological sites, boat excursions on Lake Atitlán, Rio Dulce, the Caño Negro/Río Frío area and the Tárcoles River, zip lines and hanging bridges in Monteverde, Manuel Antonio National Park and a 4×4 trip to the summit of Barú Volcano.

## Transfers and accommodation

The first seven days are in Guatemala: Villa Colonial in Antigua, Villa Santa Catarina near Lake Atitlán, Barceló Guatemala City, Villa Maya near Tikal and Villa Caribe in Livingston.

The journey then crosses into Honduras, with accommodation at Clarion Ruinas Copan in the Copán area. In El Salvador, the programme lists Barceló San Salvador.

On Day 11, the route continues via La Unión and a ferry to Nicaragua, followed by León and Managua. The approved accommodation list specifies Hotel Los Robles for Day 11 and Hotel Real La Merced in Granada for Day 12.

The next overland crossing leads into Costa Rica, with Arenal Paraíso Resort & Spa near Arenal, Montaña Monteverde in Monteverde and Mimos Hotel near Manuel Antonio.

The journey ends in Panama: La Casa de La Abuela in Boquete, TRYP by Wyndham Panama Centro in Panama City and Playa Blanca Beach Resort Panamá for the final beach days.

The programme combines road transport, boats, a ferry, two domestic flights and several river excursions. Together, these connections form one journey through six Central American countries.
